description: Administer the index — one tool, one `action`; nothing here answers a question about the code.

Read the `staleness` list, not the `stale` boolean: `data` (sources newer than the index) is fixed by `action='refresh'`; `schema` with a NEWER index is not fixable by a rebuild; `code` (this process older than its source) needs a client restart, and a build through it is REFUSED. `derived` means a fast in-place refresh is awaiting its full refresh. Reads are always current.

`action='status'` is the full diagnosis — not a session opener, since every reply already carries `target` and any `staleness`. `stats` grades an index; `cull` deletes aged-out or version-stale ones. A declaration naming an unknown section is refused by name.
